title: Austin Denies Cable Franchise Changes
summary:
*   Austin Cablevision's request to modify its operating franchise was unanimously denied.
*   The cable provider was directed to come into compliance with its existing franchise agreement within 45 days.
*   This significant policy decision was made during a special meeting, concluding in just over 10 minutes.
